vIHr6595karpNpyRi7SO-g.zh: 日本德島縣9/23報告29例病例,均為70歲以上長者,分布於2間⻑照機構,於9/16-17出現腹瀉等急性腸胃炎症狀,經採檢,其中5 例測出產氣莢膜桿菌陽性,疑感染源為團膳業者供應之餐點,當局已要求業者清消並停業5天。
vIHr6595karpNpyRi7SO-g.en: Tokushima Prefecture in Japan reported 29 cases on 23 September, all aged 70 or over, distributed across two long-term care facilities. Acute gastroenteritis symptoms, including diarrhoea, appeared on 16–17 September. Of those tested, 5 cases were positive for Clostridium perfringens. The suspected source is meals supplied by a catering contractor; authorities have ordered the operator to disinfect its facilities and suspended its business for five days.

BAaH0svth5bz8cMjEeaSfA.zh: 日本疫情上升,今年第35週(8/24-30)報告6,543例確定病例(高於去年同期1,347例),定醫平均報告1.76例(高於去年同期0.35),住院213例,較上週(167例)增加,其中以70歲以上(108例)佔50.7%為主。主要分佈於沖繩縣(8.5)、岩手縣(4.33)及新潟縣(3.58)等地,全國47個都道府縣中,39個都道府縣病例數較前一週增加。 韓國疫情微幅上升,該國定醫通報數今年第35週上升至每千人13.3例,高於上週9.2例;病毒陽性率為12.3%,高於上週10%,主要以A(H1N1)pdm09型別為主。當局於9/4呼籲團體活動(包括兒童和學生)應遵守個人健康準則,⺠眾應勤洗手、佩戴口罩及接種疫苗等呼吸道防治措施。
BAaH0svth5bz8cMjEeaSfA.en: Japan's epidemic is rising: in week 35 of this year (24–30 August), 6,543 confirmed cases were reported, 1,347 more than the same period last year. The average reported per sentinel site was 1.76, 0.35 higher than last year, and 213 were hospitalised, up from 167 the previous week; cases aged 70 and over (108) accounted for 50.7%. Cases are mainly distributed in Okinawa Prefecture (8.5), Iwate Prefecture (4.33) and Niigata Prefecture (3.58); of Japan's 47 prefectures, 39 reported more cases than the previous week. South Korea's epidemic rose slightly: the sentinel physician reports of influenza-like illness (ILI) in week 35 rose to 13.3 per 1,000, up from 9.2 the previous week, and the virus positivity rate was 12.3%, up from 10% the previous week, mainly A(H1N1)pdm09. On 4 September the authorities called on group activities (including those involving children and students) to follow personal health guidelines, and urged the public to practise respiratory protection measures such as frequent hand washing, wearing masks and vaccination.

GHKrCYlbbo7Mxfj3DPxgMQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,厚生勞動省8/28宣布全國進入流行期,今年第34週(8/17-23)報告4,094例確定病例(高於去年同期1,183例),定醫平均報告1.11例(高於去年同期0.31),住院167例,較上週(120例)增加,其中以70歲以上(84例)佔50%為主。主要分佈地區為沖繩縣(4.43)、岩手縣(2.1)及青森縣(2.08)等地,該國呼籲⺠眾勤洗手、戴口罩及施打疫苗等落實基本防護措施。
GHKrCYlbbo7Mxfj3DPxgMQ.en: Japan's epidemic is rising. On 28 August the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare declared that the whole country had entered the epidemic period. In week 34 of this year (17–23 August), 4,094 confirmed cases were reported, 1,183 more than the same period last year; the average per sentinel site was 1.11, 0.31 higher than last year, and 167 were hospitalised, up from 120 the previous week; cases aged 70 and over (84) accounted for 50%. The main distribution is in Okinawa Prefecture (4.43), Iwate Prefecture (2.1) and Aomori Prefecture (2.08). Authorities urge people to practise basic protective measures such as frequent hand washing, wearing masks and vaccination.

AQ6cjWBJ70qB9Yz22pzyaw.zh: 日本疫情仍處高點,今年第29週(7/13-19)累計報告2萬1,078例病例,略高於第28週(2萬557例),定醫平均病例數為9.35例,顯著高於去年同期(0.57例),且為2021年以來次高。另今年截至7/19累計9萬7,929例手足口病病例,檢出型別以克沙奇A6型為多。
AQ6cjWBJ70qB9Yz22pzyaw.en: Japan's outbreak remains at a peak. In week 29 of this year (13–19 July), 21,078 cases were reported, slightly higher than week 28 (20,557 cases). The average number of cases per sentinel clinic is 9.35, significantly higher than the same period last year (0.57), and the second-highest since 2021. In addition, as of 19 July this year, 97,929 cumulative hand, foot and mouth disease cases have been reported, with Coxsackievirus A6 as the predominant type detected.

AkK3YqwSJzNcu4PNWqnk6A.zh: 日本疫情於高點,今年第28週(7/6-12)累計報告2萬557例手足口病病例,較前1週(1萬5,848例)增加30%,定醫平均病例數為9.12例,顯著高於去年同期(0.57例),且為近5年次高。另今年截至7/5累計7萬6,772例病例。
AkK3YqwSJzNcu4PNWqnk6A.en: Japan's outbreak is at its peak. In week 28 of this year (6–12 July), 20,557 hand, foot and mouth disease cases were reported, an increase of 30% from the previous week (15,848 cases). The average number per sentinel clinic was 9.12, significantly higher than the same period last year (0.57) and the second-highest in the past five years. In addition, as of 5 July this year, 76,772 cases have been reported cumulatively.

IZV-LnLXRlESuYewL7e1UQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,今年截至6/7累計報告72例病例,高於去年同期(該國去年共報告192例病例,病例數為近年來最高),已有26個都道府縣報告病例,以往病例主要分布於該國西部及中部地區,去年疫情向北部及東部地區蔓延,地理分布範圍擴大,該疾病疫情通常自每年3月開始上升,並於5-10月達高峰 。
IZV-LnLXRlESuYewL7e1UQ.en: Cases in Japan are rising. As of 7 June this year, 72 cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the same period last year. Japan reported 192 cases last year, the highest in recent years. Cases have now been reported from 26 prefectures. Previously, cases were mainly in the western and central regions of the country; last year the outbreak spread to northern and eastern regions, expanding the geographic range. The disease season usually begins to rise in March each year and peaks between May and October.

rHOXeEPfBZ9tyZ9gdbofAw.zh: 日本今年迄今累計511例病例,已逾去年全年病例數(265例),近4週增幅趨緩,感染者多為20至29歲族群,以東京都、神奈川縣及埼玉縣為多,境外移入感染國以印為多,多數病例接種史不明、未接種或接種1劑疫苗。 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,自今年3月爆發疫情迄今累計報告70,936例病例(9,049例確診),585例相關死亡病例(90例確診),達卡地區最為嚴峻(6,306例確診)。
rHOXeEPfBZ9tyZ9gdbofAw.en: Japan has reported 511 cumulative cases so far this year, already exceeding the full-year total for last year (265 cases). The increase has slowed over the past four weeks. Most infected people are aged 20–29, with the most cases in Tokyo Metropolis, Kanagawa Prefecture and Saitama Prefecture. Among imported cases, most were acquired in India. Most cases had an unknown vaccination history, were unvaccinated, or had received one dose of vaccine. Bangladesh's outbreak is severe: since it began in March this year, 70,936 cases (9,049 confirmed) and 585 related deaths (90 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively. The Dhaka region is the most severely affected, with 6,306 confirmed cases.

zOaubkko1I395wkdn2x6nw.zh: 今年第18 週(5/4-10)全球陽性率下降為0.86%,其中,東南亞、東地中海、非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占26.81%)、其次為BA.3.2(占23.91%)及XFG(占21.01%)。 中國疫情於低點略降,第21 週(5/18-24)門急診陽性率略降為1.5%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 日本疫情於低點略增,第20週(5/11-17)平均定醫報告數增為0.37,近期住院病例以80歲以上為多。
zOaubkko1I395wkdn2x6nw.en: In week 18 (4–10 May), the global positivity rate fell to 0.86%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia, the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. Circulating variants are mainly NB.1.8.1 (26.81%), followed by BA.3.2 (23.91%) and XFG (21.01%). In China, the positivity rate at outpatient and emergency visits fell slightly to 1.5% in week 21 (18–24 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In Japan, activity rose slightly from a low point: the average number of reports per designated sentinel clinic rose to 0.37 in week 20 (11–17 May), and recent hospitalised cases were mainly aged 80 and over.

hKWZjDsLsQs0zQ5bVBwAMA.zh: 日本今年第19週(5/4-10)整體急性呼吸道感染(ARI)數,較第18週下降近4成,評估係因黃金週「休診效應」影響。另3月呼吸道陽性檢體中,以B型流感病毒(占25.5%) 與鼻病毒或腸病毒(占14.9%)為多,其次為人類間質肺炎病毒(占6%)。
hKWZjDsLsQs0zQ5bVBwAMA.en: In week 19 of this year (4–10 May), Japan's overall number of acute respiratory infections (ARI) fell by nearly 40% compared with week 18. This is assessed to be due to the effect of Golden Week clinic closures. Among respiratory specimens positive in March, influenza B virus accounted for the largest share (25.5%), followed by rhinovirus or enterovirus (14.9%) and human metapneumovirus (6%).

6Fjg9E94V4tqQCSc06M8cw.zh: 日本九州福岡縣近期出現「神秘感冒」,於黃金週後,診所求診數較往年增加2至3成,並擴散至關東地區。病患症狀多為喉嚨劇痛、久咳帶痰及鼻水,惟新冠及流感快篩皆呈陰性。福岡縣醫師會表示初步推測應為人類間質肺炎病毒(hMPV)等常見呼吸道病毒,惟仍待釐清,暫排除新興傳染病之可能性。目前該國呼吸道傳染病監測數據亦顯示通報數未達警戒標準,醫界呼籲民眾毋需過度恐慌。
6Fjg9E94V4tqQCSc06M8cw.en: A so-called 'mysterious cold' has emerged in Fukuoka Prefecture in Kyushu, Japan. After the Golden Week holiday, clinic visits have risen by 20–30% compared with previous years, and the illness has spread to the Kanto region. Symptoms are mostly severe sore throat, prolonged cough with sputum, and runny nose, but rapid tests for COVID-19 and influenza are negative. The Fukuoka Medical Association said the preliminary assessment is that it is likely a common respiratory virus such as human metapneumovirus (hMPV), though this still needs to be clarified; a novel emerging infectious disease has been tentatively ruled out. Surveillance data for Japan's respiratory infectious diseases also show that reports have not reached alert thresholds, and medical bodies urge the public not to panic unnecessarily.

G17274ZsLFbVFKhGUWPpsg.zh: 日本疫情升溫,今年截至 4/30 累計報告 436 例,已超越去年同期(96 例)。疫情以東京都(211 例)最為嚴重,佔全國病例數 48%,其次為神奈川縣(40 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)。該國表示此波疫情係境外移入個案所致,並與疫苗接種率下降有關,病例以青少年及年輕成人為主,呼籲民眾應完成兩劑疫苗接種,且出國前應確認疫苗接種狀態。本署已將該國旅遊疫情建議等級提升為「第一級:注意」。
G17274ZsLFbVFKhGUWPpsg.en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 30 April this year, 436 cases had been reported cumulatively, already above the same period last year (96 cases). Tokyo Metropolis is the most severely affected, with 211 cases, accounting for 48% of national cases, followed by Kanagawa Prefecture (40 cases) and Kagoshima Prefecture (34 cases). The country attributes this wave to imported cases and links it to declining vaccination coverage. Cases are mainly among adolescents and young adults. The public is urged to complete two doses of vaccine and to confirm vaccination status before travelling abroad. The Taiwan CDC has raised Japan's travel epidemic advisory level to Level 1: Watch.

6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,今年截至4/22累計報告362例,高於去(2025) 年全年病例數(265 例),分布以東京都(153 例)、神奈川縣(36 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)、千葉縣(24 例)及愛知縣(23 例)為多,其中 33 例為境外移入病例,59%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 孟加拉自今年 3/15 疫情爆發,截至 4/17 累計報告逾 3 萬例疑病例(含 4,460 例確診),其中 251 例病例死亡(含 42 例確診),疫情目前已擴及全國,當局目前亦面臨檢測試劑短缺問題。 巴基斯坦今年截至 3 月累計報告 4,541 例確定病例及 71 例兒童死亡病例,其中以北部開伯爾-普什圖省(1,712 例)、中部旁遮普省(1,198 例)及東南部信德省(1,183 例)為多,此次疫情係因該國於COVID-19 流行期間中斷預防接種作業而產生大量未接種疫苗兒童族群所致,當局刻正規劃擴大預防接種作業。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年累計報告 10,065 例確定病例及 72 例死亡病例,死亡病例多發生於交通不便地區,當局已提供免費醫療及疫苗接種服務。
6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.en: Japan: the outbreak has risen sharply, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 22 April this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (265 cases). Cases are concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (153), Kanagawa Prefecture (36), Kagoshima Prefecture (34), Chiba Prefecture (24) and Aichi Prefecture (23). Of these, 33 were imported, and 59% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Bangladesh: since the outbreak began on 15 March this year, more than 30,000 suspected cases (including 4,460 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively as of 17 April, of which 251 died (including 42 confirmed). The outbreak has now spread across the country, and authorities face a shortage of testing reagents. Pakistan: as of March this year, 4,541 confirmed cases and 71 child deaths had been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in the northern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (1,712), central Punjab Province (1,198) and south-eastern Sindh Province (1,183). The outbreak is attributed to the large number of unvaccinated children created when immunisation was suspended during the COVID-19 pandemic, and authorities are planning to expand immunisation. DRC: South Kivu Province in eastern DRC has reported 10,065 confirmed cases and 72 deaths cumulatively this year. Most deaths occurred in areas with poor transport access, and authorities have provided free medical care and vaccination services.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,今(2026)年截至 4/8 累計報告 236 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印12例為多,其次為紐西蘭7例,以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 72 例、鹿兒島縣27 例、愛知縣 23 例及神奈川/千葉縣 20 例為多。 美國疫情持續,今年截至 4/9 共 33 州累計報告 1,704 例確定病例,其中 96 例住院,病患以 5-19 歲年齡層族群(888 例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(667 例),其次為猶他州(408)及德州(176 例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他州。
PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 8 April this year, 236 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. Indonesia accounted for the most imported cases (12), followed by New Zealand (7). Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (72 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (27), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa and Chiba Prefectures (20) reported the most. The United States outbreak continues: as of 9 April, 1,704 confirmed cases have been reported across 33 states this year, of which 96 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (888 cases), concentrated in South Carolina (667 cases), followed by Utah (408) and Texas (176). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah.

smH6p3eVvSDSOGNmI827Jw.zh: 日本岡山縣倉敷市4/1報告某餐廳發生諾羅病毒感染群聚事件,累計報告24例病例,占整體用餐顧客的44%。另該縣今年累計報告7起食物中毒群聚事件,疫情高於去年同期,其中5起由諾羅病毒引起。
smH6p3eVvSDSOGNmI827Jw.en: On 1 April, Kurashiki City in Okayama Prefecture, Japan, reported a norovirus infection cluster at a restaurant, with 24 cases reported cumulatively, accounting for 44% of all diners. In addition, the prefecture has reported 7 foodborne cluster outbreaks this year, higher than the same period last year, 5 of them caused by norovirus.

0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至4/1累計報告197例,其中28例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占50%),分布以東京都48例、鹿兒島縣24例、愛知縣23例及神奈川縣19例為多。該國去(2025)年報告265例確定病例。 孟加拉疫情上升,該國今年截至3月累計報告722例確定病例,其中僅3月即報告514例,57%病例為6個月以下嬰兒,自3月中旬以來已報告逾7,600例疑病例,近6週報告逾113例死亡,當局已針對30個高風險地區,共計逾130萬名6個月至5歲以下兒童啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。 美洲疫情持續,墨西哥今年截至4/6累計報告8,750例確定病例,其中9例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(5,062例)為多;美國今年截至4/2共33州累計報告1,671例確定病例,猶他州近期疫情上升;加拿大今年截至3/21累計報告650例確定病例,病例數以曼托巴省(392例)及亞伯達省(209例)為多;瓜地馬拉疫情上升,今年截至3/29共計22省累計報告3,594例確定病例,其中54%病例集中於中南部瓜地馬拉省,該國正聖週期間,宗教活動及旅遊增加,預期病例數將持續上升。
0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 1 April this year, 197 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 28 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (48 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (24), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa Prefecture (19) reported the most. Japan reported 265 confirmed cases last year. Bangladesh's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 722 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 514 were reported in March alone; 57% of cases were infants under 6 months old. Since mid-March, more than 7,600 suspected cases have been reported, and more than 113 deaths were reported over the past six weeks. Authorities have launched emergency vaccination for more than 1.3 million children aged 6 months to under 5 years in 30 high-risk areas. The outbreak in the Americas continues: as of 6 April this year, Mexico has reported 8,750 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 9 deaths, with most cases in western Jalisco State (5,062 cases). As of 2 April this year, the United States has reported 1,671 confirmed cases across 33 states, and the outbreak in Utah has recently risen. As of 21 March this year, Canada has reported 650 confirmed cases, mainly in Manitoba (392 cases) and Alberta (209 cases). Guatemala's outbreak is rising: as of 29 March this year, 3,594 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 departments, with 54% concentrated in Guatemala Department in the central-south. During Holy Week, religious activities and travel increased, and case numbers are expected to continue rising.

uXZ5Y2MsnWbBP59xBfRUmA.zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至3/18累計報告139例,其中27例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占53%),分布以東京都32例、愛知縣23例及千葉縣16例為多。另鹿兒島縣於3/25報告群聚事件,共計13例病例與3/2舉辦之高中畢業典禮相關,該縣自3/6報告首例以來,累計報告22例確定病例,當局已公佈於傳染期內有密集接觸人群之病例活動史,另提醒民眾倘有疑症狀,應及時就醫。
uXZ5Y2MsnWbBP59xBfRUmA.en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 18 March this year, 139 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 27 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (53%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (32 cases), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Chiba Prefecture (16) reported the most. In addition, Kagoshima Prefecture reported a cluster on 25 March: 13 cases were linked to a high school graduation ceremony held on 2 March. Since the prefecture's first case was reported on 6 March, 22 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities have published the activity histories of cases who had dense contact with people during their infectious period, and reminded the public to seek medical care promptly if they have suspicious symptoms.

qUmACq873FVbUWHVA3ACTg.zh: 日本今(2026)年截至第9週累計報告87例,為2020年以來同期累計最高,其中15例為境外移入病例,多來自東南亞國家,病患年齡以15-29年齡層為多(占47%),近期病例多分布於愛知縣、東京都。當局已發布警告,呼籲自境外返國者應留意自身健康狀況、各都道府縣應確保兒童按時接種疫苗,並於前往流行地區時確認疫苗接種記錄。
qUmACq873FVbUWHVA3ACTg.en: Japan reported 87 cases cumulatively this year through week 9, the highest cumulative figure for the same period since 2020. Of these, 15 were imported, mostly from Southeast Asian countries. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (47%), and recent cases are mainly distributed in Aichi Prefecture and Tokyo Metropolis. Authorities have issued a warning calling on people returning from overseas to be aware of their own health, on prefectures to ensure children are vaccinated on schedule, and on travellers to epidemic areas to check their vaccination records.

Vf9CMmVPsXiFWnHFIplxAw.zh: 日本疫情呈波動下降趨勢,第9週(2/23-3/1)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告降至6.31例,較2025年同期(9.83例)低,惟疫情仍高於2021-24年同期,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第9週報告424例病例,疫情已連續4週下降,較2025年同期為低,惟疫情仍高於2021-24年同期。
Vf9CMmVPsXiFWnHFIplxAw.en: Japan's outbreak is on a fluctuating downward trend. In week 9 (23 February–1 March), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis fell to 6.31 cases, lower than the 9.83 cases in the same period of 2025, but still higher than the same period in 2021–2024. The pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is on a downward trend: it reported 424 cases in week 9, has declined for four consecutive weeks, and is lower than the same period in 2025, but still higher than the same period in 2021–2024.

3BYzxQMJV83W4uijUoElRQ.zh: 香港3/1報告1起郵輪群聚事件,累計報告76例疑病例,其中有7件檢體呈陽性;最早有症狀旅客係於2/15從日本橫濱登船後發病,該郵輪共有約2,000名乘客及800名工作人員。 日本疫情於高點波動,第8週(2/16-22)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告增至8.02例,較2025年同期(10.32例)低,惟疫情仍高於近5年同期平均,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第8週(2/15-21)報告456例病例,疫情已連續3週下降,惟仍高於近5年同期。
3BYzxQMJV83W4uijUoElRQ.en: On 1 March, Hong Kong reported one cruise ship cluster, with 76 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 7 specimens tested positive. The earliest symptomatic passenger had boarded in Yokohama, Japan, on 15 February and fell ill afterwards. The cruise ship carried about 2,000 passengers and 800 crew members. Japan's outbreak is fluctuating at a high level. In week 8 (16–22 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis increased to 8.02 cases, lower than the 10.32 cases in the same period of 2025 but still higher than the five-year average for the same period. The pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is declining: it reported 456 cases in week 8 (15–21 February), with three consecutive weeks of decline, but still higher than the five-year average for the same period.

7i5ZdBwd5pjpRYCMoDiExA.zh: 日本今年截至第7週累計報告43例,為2020年以來同期累計最高,病患年齡以10-19歲居多(占56%),近期病例多分布於東京都、大阪府;當局已發布警告,呼籲加強通報、疫調等防疫措施。
7i5ZdBwd5pjpRYCMoDiExA.en: Japan reported 43 cases cumulatively this year through week 7, the highest for the same period since 2020. Patients are mainly aged 10–19 years (56%), and recent cases are mainly distributed in Tokyo Metropolis and Osaka Prefecture. Authorities have issued a warning calling for strengthened reporting, epidemiological investigation and other prevention measures.

o-qonNIuJd3w3wregW3V1Q.zh: 日本疫情略降,第7週(2/9-15)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告7.98例,為5年同期最高,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情略降,第7週報告613例病例,惟仍處高點,為近5年最高。 英國疫情下降,第6-7週累計報告981例病例,惟仍高於近5年同期平均。
o-qonNIuJd3w3wregW3V1Q.en: Japan's outbreak is declining slightly. In week 7 (9–15 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 7.98 cases, the highest for the same period in five years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is declining slightly: it reported 613 cases in week 7; it remains at a high point and is the highest in five years. The United Kingdom's outbreak has declined: it reported 981 cases cumulatively in weeks 6–7, but remains higher than the five-year average for the same period.

vladke6-ywGphmeYzrZVNA.zh: 日本疫情更新,第7週(2/9-15)定點門診平均病例數為41.44例,全國病例數逾15萬例,主要型別為B型(65%),平均病例數以大分縣(64.43例)、埼玉縣(62.6例)及鹿兒島 (62.12例)為多。另共計35個都道縣平均病例數超過30例警戒,本流感季平均病例數在去(2025)年11月下旬達到高峰51.12例後,於年底下降,惟自今(2026)年1月起持續上升,截至2/15當週,該國共計8,174所學校因流感停課,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。
vladke6-ywGphmeYzrZVNA.en: Japan's outbreak update: in week 7 (9–15 February), the average number of cases at sentinel outpatient clinics was 41.44, with more than 150,000 cases nationwide. The main type is type B (65%). By prefecture, average case numbers were highest in Oita (64.43), Saitama (62.6) and Kagoshima (62.12). A total of 35 prefectures had average case numbers above the warning level of 30. The average case number for this flu season peaked at 51.12 in late November last year and fell at year-end, but has risen continuously since January this year. As of the week of 15 February, 8,174 schools nationwide had suspended classes due to influenza. Authorities urge the public to maintain thorough hand hygiene, wear masks and take other protective measures.

RC5AtJYdnCyVR8_m4Cvx4g.zh: 日本疫情持續上升,第5週(1/26-2/1)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告9.42例,疫情為近10年同期最高,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情持續攀升,第5週(1/25-31)報告709例病例,疫情為近5年最高,病患以0-6歲佔最多。 香港今年1月起食物中毒案件增加,1/18-2/9累計報告37起食物中毒案件(共影響115人),其中33起(89%)與諾羅病毒相關,共101例病例,疑感染源為韓國、法國及愛爾蘭等地生產的生蠔。
RC5AtJYdnCyVR8_m4Cvx4g.en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 5 (26 January–1 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 9.42 cases, the highest for the same period in the past 10 years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak continues to climb: it reported 709 cases in week 5 (25–31 January), the highest in five years, with children aged 0–6 years accounting for the largest share. In Hong Kong, food poisoning incidents have increased since January this year. Between 18 January and 9 February, 37 food poisoning incidents were reported cumulatively, affecting 115 people, of which 33 (89%) were linked to norovirus, with 101 cases in total. The suspected source of infection is oysters produced in South Korea, France and Ireland.

W_NcJaKzoFZJf-Pe1VW68w.zh: 日本疫情上升,今年第5週(1/26-2/1)定點門診平均病例數為30.03例,約為第4週病例數2倍,已連續4週上升,全國病例數約為11萬例,較前1週新增5萬餘例,A型流感(56%)及B型(44%)共同流行,平均病例數以大分(52.48例)、鹿兒島 (49.6例)、山梨及千葉縣為多,預期疫情仍會持續2週,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。東京都第5週平均病例數為26.67例,發布本流感季第2次警報,其於去年11月發布首次警報,今年1月解除,為該都自1999年以來,於同一季發布兩次警報。
W_NcJaKzoFZJf-Pe1VW68w.en: Japan's outbreak is rising. In week 5 (26 January–1 February), the average number of sentinel outpatient cases was 30.03, about twice the number in week 4, and it has risen for four consecutive weeks. Nationwide case numbers were about 110,000, with more than 50,000 new cases compared with the previous week. Influenza A (56%) and B (44%) are circulating together. By prefecture, averages were highest in Oita (52.48), Kagoshima (49.6), Yamanashi and Chiba. The epidemic is expected to continue for two more weeks, and authorities urge the public to maintain thorough hand hygiene and wear masks, among other protective measures. Tokyo's average case number in week 5 was 26.67, and Tokyo has issued the second warning of this flu season. It had issued the first warning in late November last year and lifted it in January this year; this is the first time since 1999 that Tokyo has issued two warnings in the same season.

mfeWlEkGdvN5nUDLlUQkuw.zh: 日本今年第4週(1/19-25)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告8.55例,疫情已連續3週上升,致病原多為諾羅病毒,病患分佈以群馬縣及岐阜縣為多,當局呼籲民眾如廁後,徹底洗手,清理嘔吐物時,佩戴手套及口罩。
mfeWlEkGdvN5nUDLlUQkuw.en: In week 4 (19–25 January), the average number of infectious gastroenteritis cases reported at Japan's sentinel clinics was 8.55, and the trend has risen for three consecutive weeks. The causative pathogen is mostly norovirus, with cases concentrated in Gunma and Gifu prefectures. Authorities urge people to wash their hands thoroughly after using the toilet, and to wear gloves and a mask when cleaning up vomit.

mexrQChxAP80tYr1nkC22w.zh: 日本疫情上升,第4週(1/19-25)定點門診平均病例數為16.64例,第1週為10.35例,已連續3週上升,全國病例數約為6.3萬例,較前1週新增2萬例,其中,鹿兒島縣平均病例數超過30例,病患以A型流感(占74%)為主,惟B型(占26%)流感正在上升,當局呼籲民眾落實勤洗手及佩戴口罩等防護措施。
mexrQChxAP80tYr1nkC22w.en: Japan's influenza activity is rising. In week 4 (19–25 January), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 16.64, up from 10.35 in week 1, and the trend has risen for three consecutive weeks. Nationwide case numbers were about 63,000, an increase of 20,000 from the previous week. Kagoshima Prefecture averaged more than 30 cases per clinic. Type A influenza (74%) predominates, while type B (26%) is increasing. Authorities urge people to wash their hands frequently and wear masks.

kpXAzGYnX_qX6u8ld3VU8A.zh: 日本福岡市城南區1/26報告10例疑病例,其中有8例檢驗確診,病患為托兒所學生;另該市喬南區亦有通報病例,當局已公告示警,呼籲民眾加強衛生與清消措施。
kpXAzGYnX_qX6u8ld3VU8A.en: Fukuoka City's Jonan Ward reported 10 suspected cases on 26 January, 8 of which were laboratory-confirmed; the patients are nursery school children. A second ward, recorded in the source as 喬南區, has also reported cases. Authorities have issued a public alert and urge the public to strengthen hygiene and disinfection measures.

0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.zh: 韓國疫情自2025年11月起持續攀升,今年迄第2週止已新增548例病例,為近5年同期最高,其中6歲以下病患占約4成;該國疫情好發於11-3月,主要感染源為受汙染的地下水或海鮮,亦可能透過接觸病患的飛沫或嘔吐物感染,當局呼籲注意個人衛生,尤其托兒機構等應加強衛生防護措施。 中國廣東省佛山市1/17報告某高中群聚事件,累計103例病例,迄無重症或死亡病例,當局已展開調查,加強衛生教育與清消;另中國有78-93%的諾羅疫情發生於校園,疫情流行於10-3月。 日本岩手縣1/20報告1起托嬰中心群聚事件,累計22例病例,包括21名幼童及1名工作人員,其中有4例檢驗呈陽性,發病日介於1/7-18。
0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.en: South Korea's situation has risen continuously since November 2025, with 548 new cases reported through week 2 of this year, the highest for the same period in the past five years. About 40% of patients were under 6 years old. Outbreaks typically occur from November to March, mainly from contaminated groundwater or seafood, and infection can also occur through respiratory droplets or contact with patients' vomit. Authorities urge attention to personal hygiene, and childcare facilities in particular should strengthen hygiene and protection measures. On 17 January, Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, reported a cluster at a senior high school, with 103 cumulative cases; no severe or fatal cases have been recorded. Authorities have launched an investigation and are strengthening health education and disinfection. In China, 78–93% of norovirus outbreaks occur in schools, and outbreaks are prevalent from October to March. On 20 January, Iwate Prefecture in Japan reported a cluster at a nursery centre, with 22 cumulative cases, including 21 young children and 1 staff member; 4 tested positive, with onset dates between 7 and 18 January.

KyywM_0m3yW03adOH7Y3jQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,2025年已有32個都道府縣累計報告達191例病例,病例數為近年來最高,主要分布於該國西部地區,以高知縣15例、靜岡縣及大分縣各13例為多,並逐漸向東部蔓延,神奈川縣亦出現首例。
KyywM_0m3yW03adOH7Y3jQ.en: Japan's situation is rising. In 2025, 191 cases were reported cumulatively across 32 prefectures, the highest in recent years. Cases are mainly in western Japan, with the most in Kochi prefecture (15 cases), and 13 each in Shizuoka and Oita prefectures. The disease is gradually spreading eastward, and the first case has also appeared in Kanagawa prefecture.

-aVjBLvJ2mn7hmGyn7pgmA.zh: 日本2025年截至第50週累計報告逾1.3萬例確定病例,以東京都3,264例為多,其次為大阪府(1,637例)及愛知縣(818例),另愛媛縣(155例)為歷年最高,當局已提供電話諮詢及免費匿名篩檢服務,並呼籲民眾應正確使用保險套,疑感染者應立即接受檢測。 韓國2025年截至11月累計報告2,036例確定病例,年齡層以20-30歲為主,當局持續宣導安全性行為及早期檢測之重要性;該國自2024年起梅毒由抽樣監測調整為全面通報,2024年累計報告2,790例。
-aVjBLvJ2mn7hmGyn7pgmA.en: Japan reported more than 13,000 confirmed cases cumulatively in 2025 through week 50. The most were in Tokyo Metropolis (3,264), followed by Osaka Prefecture (1,637) and Aichi Prefecture (818). Ehime Prefecture (155) recorded its highest number on record. Authorities have provided telephone consultation and free anonymous screening services, urge people to use condoms correctly, and advise anyone with suspected infection to be tested immediately. South Korea reported 2,036 confirmed cases cumulatively through November 2025, mainly among those aged 20–30; authorities continue to promote safe sex and early testing. Since 2024, South Korea has changed syphilis reporting from sample-based surveillance to full notification; 2,790 cases were reported in 2024.

gkVoXu3rj-Td9juqMIet-A.zh: 日本東京都報告1例確定病例,為30多歲駕駛巴士往返東京羽田及其他機場之男性司機,無出國旅遊史,病患於12/23出現發燒、睛充血及皮疹等症狀,同日下午曾至東京豐洲五金行停留,24日執勤於羽田/成田機場出發之巴士,當局已啟動疫情調查及接觸者匡列作業,並呼籲曾有相同活動史之民眾勿搭乘大眾運輸工具,倘出現發燒、皮疹、咳嗽、流鼻水或睛充血等疑麻疹症狀,應及時就醫。東京都今年累計報告33例確定病例,其中63%為本土感染。 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至12/26共計26州報告6,050例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(4,481例)、中西部哈利斯科州(516例)、西南部雷羅州(237例)為多,另死亡病例以契瓦瓦州21例為多。疫情自11月起反彈上升,近4週確診逾100例,病患主要年齡層為0-4歲兒童(1,559例),其次為25-29歲(690例)及5-9歲(655例)年齡層,90%以上未接種疫苗。
gkVoXu3rj-Td9juqMIet-A.en: Tokyo Metropolis reported one confirmed case: a man in his 30s who drives buses between Tokyo's Haneda airport and other airports, with no history of overseas travel. The patient developed fever, conjunctival injection and rash on 23 December. That afternoon he visited a hardware store in Toyosu, Tokyo, and on 24 December he worked on buses departing from Haneda and Narita airports. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and contact identification, and urge people with the same activity history not to use public transport. Anyone who develops fever, rash, cough, runny nose or conjunctival injection should seek medical care promptly. Tokyo has reported 33 confirmed cases so far this year, 63% of them locally acquired. Mexico's situation is rising. As of 26 December this year, 26 states had reported 6,050 confirmed cases, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,481), Jalisco state in the central-west (516) and Guerrero state in the southwest (237); deaths were most numerous in Chihuahua (21). The outbreak has rebounded since November, with more than 100 confirmed cases in the past four weeks. The main age group is children aged 0–4 (1,559 cases), followed by those aged 25–29 (690) and 5–9 (655). Over 90% were unvaccinated.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

Japan reported more than 82,000 cases cumulatively as of 19 October this year, the highest since 2018. mQW9PsXlG_Kr1YUd7FcQEw.en: Australia's outbreak is severe: more than 420,000 cases have been reported this year, and 265 deaths as of August this year. This is the first time since February 2020 that influenza deaths have exceeded COVID-19 deaths. A prolonged peak lasted from late June to mid-August, and the rate of decline is slower than in previous seasons. Over 10% of cases are children under 5 years old. Vaccination coverage in the country this year is low, at about 30.6%; only about 25% of children under 5 have been vaccinated, and vaccination rates among the elderly have also declined. Japan: The outbreak continues to rise. Tokyo, Chiba, Saitama and Kanagawa had averages above 10 cases, and case numbers rose from the previous week in all 44 prefectures. Authorities say they will continue monitoring the outbreak to respond to its spread and urge people to take personal protective measures and get vaccinated. Hong Kong remains at a high level: positivity in the past week (19–25 October) was 12.01%. The recently detected strain is mainly A(H3), accounting for nearly 90% of virus detections. School cluster reports also remain at a high level: from the start of the school term in September to 29 October, 693 school clusters were reported, along with 16 severe paediatric cases, including one death. Wastewater virus surveillance will also now cover seasonal influenza viruses as a supplementary indicator to the traditional surveillance system.

YVJD3VFU4oPz_2s9FK1Mew.en: China: Week 43 (20–26 October) surveillance shows activity and positivity rates rising in both the south and the north, with A(H3N2) as the main circulating type. Experts say temperatures have dropped sharply recently, marking the start of the respiratory disease season. Neighbouring countries have recently entered their flu seasons early, and the influenza peak is expected between late November and mid-December. Hong Kong is at its summer flu-season peak: the positivity rate in week 42 (12–18 October) was 11.84%, with A(H3N2) as the main type, accounting for nearly 90% of total virus detections. School cluster reports continue to rise, with 608 reported cumulatively as of 22 October. Since school started in September, 14 severe paediatric influenza cases have been reported cumulatively, including one death, with patients aged between 2 and 17. Japan: The average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic in week 42 was 3.26, an increase of 1.4-fold from the previous week. The highest figure was 15.04 in Okinawa Prefecture. Case numbers increased in 37 prefectures nationwide. In Tokyo, 71 schools had suspended classes as of 19 October, more than six times the same period last year.

Vaccination rates among pregnant women and infants have declined in recent years, but after last year's deaths, the vaccination rate among pregnant women has risen back to 73%, still below the peak of 76%. jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.

In the United States, Hawaii State's outbreak is rising: as of 31 July this year, 203 cases had been cumulatively reported, more than twice the full-year total of 84 cases last year (2024). iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.zh: 美洲地區疫情持續,截至今年6月中旬報告逾7,100例及13例死亡,與去(2024)年同期244例,上升29倍,其中以加拿大(3,170例,1例死亡)為多,其次為墨西哥(2,597例,9例死亡)及美國(1,227例,3例死亡),餘有6國病例數介於1-60例間,多數病例為境外移入,受影響族群以5歲以下兒童及10-19歲青少年最為嚴重。病例數增加顯示免疫接種缺口,PAHO呼籲各國維持95%兩劑疫苗覆蓋率。WHO表示今年截至6/6,全球報告逾18萬例疑病例及8.8萬例確診。 吉爾吉斯今年截至6/17累計報告超過8,200例,其中9例死亡,病例數以首都比什凱克、南部奧什州及北部楚伊州為多,近期西部賈拉拉巴德州病例數亦持續增加,惟該國尚未宣布爆發疫情,疫情主因與大量兒童未接種疫苗有關。 日本神奈川縣報告1例10多歲青少年,該病患曾於6/21參訪大阪萬國博覽會,於會場停留約6小時,並於當日出現症狀,7/3確診,患者近期無海外旅遊史,接觸史不明。當局及主辦單位呼籲當日前往參觀人員留意自身健康情形。
iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.en: Measles activity in the Americas continues. As of mid-June this year, more than 7,100 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, 29 times the 244 cases reported in the same period of 2024. Canada reports the most (3,170 cases, 1 death), followed by Mexico (2,597 cases, 9 deaths) and the United States (1,227 cases, 3 deaths). Six other countries have between 1 and 60 cases each. Most cases are imported. The most affected groups are children under 5 and adolescents aged 10–19. The rise in cases indicates gaps in immunization, and PAHO calls on countries to maintain 95% coverage with two doses of vaccine. WHO reports that as of 6 June this year, more than 180,000 suspected and 88,000 confirmed cases have been reported globally. Kyrgyzstan has reported more than 8,200 cumulative cases so far this year as of 17 June, including 9 deaths. Cases are mainly in the capital, Bishkek, Osh Region in the south and Chui Region in the north, and recently cases have also continued to rise in Jalal-Abad Region in the west. The country has not declared an outbreak; the main cause is that many children are unvaccinated. In Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture reported one teenager, who visited Expo 2025 Osaka on 21 June and stayed at the venue for about 6 hours, developed symptoms that day, and was confirmed on 3 July. The patient had no recent overseas travel, and the contact history is unknown. Authorities and the organizers urge those who visited on that day to monitor their health.

lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.zh: 亞洲國家第24-26週(6/8-28)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,新增約8.8萬例病例,今年迄今累計253,093例,117例重症,無死亡案例;疫情低於近2年同期;香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.7‰,為今年最高點;日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.33,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;越南今年截至4月累計報告逾1.5萬例病例,其中,胡志明市病例數較去年同期增加49%;泰國今年截至6月累計報告約2.4萬例病例,迄無死亡個案,病患年齡以0-4歲(70%)及10-14歲為多(22%)。
lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 24–26 (8–28 June): China's epidemic is rising, with about 88,000 new cases in the period. Cumulatively this year, 253,093 cases and 117 severe cases have been reported, with no deaths. The epidemic is lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.7‰, the highest point this year. Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.33 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Viet Nam reported more than 15,000 cumulative cases as of April this year, and cases in Ho Chi Minh City were 49% higher than in the same period last year. Thailand reported about 24,000 cumulative cases as of June this year, with no deaths. Patients are mainly aged 0–4 (70%) and 10–14 (22%).

G45b2iInhb6UlKUf7YY3FA.zh: 日本近1週定點平均報告數為2.53例,較前一週2.03例上升,定醫平均就診數為1999年以來新高,其中以山形縣7.62例為高,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
G45b2iInhb6UlKUf7YY3FA.en: Japan's sentinel average in the most recent week was 2.53, up from 2.03 the previous week. The average number of sentinel clinic visits is the highest since 1999, with Yamagata Prefecture highest at 7.62. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

G5pORYIARv3q4ReFK7KleQ.zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/16-22)通報3,211例,較前1週2,970例上升241例,單週新增病例數為2018年新高,以東京都(234)為多,其次為琦玉縣(204)。今年迄今已超過3.5萬例,並報告4例嬰幼兒死亡案例,另多地發現抗藥性菌株。今年病例近60%為青少年,自2018年以來,同期青少年患者比例約為10-30%,惟今年病例數顯著上升,專家表示常規疫苗保護效力至中/小學時已降低,感染風險上升,建議於小學入學前或11-12歲時接種追加劑,另呼籲政府應採取相關措施,如補貼追加劑接種費用。
G5pORYIARv3q4ReFK7KleQ.en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (16–22 June), 3,211 cases were reported, up 241 from 2,970 the previous week. Weekly new cases reached the highest level since 2018. Tokyo Metropolis (234) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (204). So far this year, more than 35,000 cases have been reported, and 4 infant and toddler deaths have been reported; drug-resistant strains have also been found in several areas. Nearly 60% of this year's cases are adolescents. Since 2018, the proportion of adolescent patients in the same period has been about 10–30%, but case numbers have risen markedly this year. Experts say routine vaccine protection has declined by the time children reach junior high or elementary school, raising infection risk. They recommend a booster before elementary school entry or at ages 11–12, and call on the government to take measures such as subsidizing booster costs.

Fy3jaKAwfVGxuVvua-6_3Q.zh: 日本靜岡縣報告1例死亡病例,為60多歲女性,6/16出現發燒、疲勞及消化問題等症狀,經檢驗確診,23日死亡,為2013年以來該縣首例報告死亡病例,沒有明顯之蜱蟲叮咬痕跡,感染途徑仍待釐清;該縣另報告1例病例,為60多歲男性,6/23確診,身體有被蜱蟲叮咬痕跡,目前住院治療中。
Fy3jaKAwfVGxuVvua-6_3Q.en: Shizuoka Prefecture in Japan reported one death, a woman in her 60s who developed fever, fatigue and digestive problems on 16 June, was confirmed by testing and died on the 23rd. This is the prefecture's first reported death since 2013. No obvious tick bite marks were found, and the route of infection remains unclear. The prefecture also reported one case, a man in his 60s confirmed on 23 June, who has tick bite marks and is currently hospitalized.

LOsxU752gRR6B43jaHX2Sw.zh: 亞洲國家第23-25週(6/1-21)疫情更新,日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.25,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;韓國疫情上升,就診陽性率2.6‰,為今年最高,惟低於近2年同期;新加坡疫情已明顯下降,平均單日新增29例病例,仍高於近5年同期;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.2‰。
LOsxU752gRR6B43jaHX2Sw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 23–25 (1–21 June): Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.25 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. South Korea's epidemic is rising, with clinic positivity of 2.6‰, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic has clearly declined, with an average of 29 new cases per day, still higher than the same period over the past 5 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.2‰.

PNJCQJGe3aEnl_CwtyHpkQ.zh: 日本近1週(6/2-6/8)定點平均報告數為2.03例,較前一週2.28例下降,單週病例數為近10年同期以來最高,其中以山形縣5.73例為高,其次為北海道4.96例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
PNJCQJGe3aEnl_CwtyHpkQ.en: In the most recent week (2–8 June), Japan's sentinel average was 2.03, down from 2.28 the previous week. The weekly case count is the highest for the same period in the past 10 years. Yamagata Prefecture was highest at 5.73, followed by Hokkaido at 4.96. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

WAqKHQE0AIBx2Y0w8NSj9Q.zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/9-6/15)通報2,970例,較前1週3,044例下降74例,病例數以東京都(189)為多,其次為琦玉縣(172)。今年迄今已超過3萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,疫情仍持續,且進入夏季後天氣炎熱,於室內活動時間增加,提高感染風險;另暑假將至,人群交流機會增加,疫情預期將持續。
WAqKHQE0AIBx2Y0w8NSj9Q.en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (9–15 June), 2,970 cases were reported, down 74 from 3,044 the previous week. Tokyo Metropolis (189) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (172). So far this year, more than 30,000 cases have been reported, and severe infant cases and infant deaths have been reported. The epidemic continues. Hot weather after the start of summer has increased indoor activity, raising infection risk, and with summer holidays approaching and more social contact, the epidemic is expected to continue.

v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第22週(5/26-6/1)全球陽性率3.5%,除非洲、西太平洋及東地中海區以外,餘區域陽性率皆上升。 馬來西亞疫情上升,5月下旬每日新增300例病例,較去年12月高峰為高,住院數亦上升,陽性率達68%;韓國疫情經4月高峰後,呈波動下降趨勢,第24週(6/8-14)新增93例病例,為第10週以來最低,陽性率為9.9%,以NB.1.8.1為主;日本第24週(6/9-15)定點平均報告數0.90例,較前一週0.92例下降,自年初以來,疫情持續下降;越南胡志明市疫情經4-5月高峰後,呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)報告32例,較前2週下降66%;香港第24週(6/8-14)陽性率4.89%,陽性率及定醫就診率持續呈下降趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,以NB.1.8.1為主要流行變異株。 美國疫情下降,自1月初每週1,000例死亡,下降至5月每週200例,第20週(5/11-17)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比最高,預測NB.1.8.1將成為主流變異株;加拿大疫情處低點,病例數自1月之每週近4,000例,下降至5月每週約500例,第22週(5/25-31)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比為高。  歐洲11國處疫情高點,第23週(6/1-7)門診陽性率10.2%,較前週高峰(10.9%)稍低,惟住院陽性率達5.9%,為今年新高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;以NB.1.8.1變異株占比最高,LP.8.1占比次高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.en: Epidemic update: In week 22 of 2025 (26 May–1 June), global positivity was 3.5%, with increases in all regions except Africa, the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. Malaysia: the epidemic is rising. Daily new cases were about 300 in late May, higher than the December peak; hospitalizations are also rising, and positivity reached 68%. South Korea: after a peak in April, the epidemic has fluctuated and declined. In week 24 (8–14 June), 93 new cases were reported, the lowest since week 10, with positivity of 9.9%, mainly NB.1.8.1. Japan: in week 24 (9–15 June) the sentinel average was 0.90, down from 0.92 the previous week, and the epidemic has continued to decline since the beginning of the year. Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: after a peak in April–May, the epidemic is declining; 32 cases were reported in week 24 (9–15 June), down 66% over the previous two weeks. Hong Kong: in week 24 (8–14 June), positivity was 4.89%. Positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continue to decline, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating variant. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

RzxjqEviDVDOzw1G0PXMNQ.zh: 亞洲國家第22-24週(5/25-6/14)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,5月新增5.2萬餘例病例;日本疫情緩升,定醫平均病例數0.19,該國今年截至6/19累計報告5例Echo11型病例;越南河內市報告單週報告新增112例病例,該市自今年截至6/13已累計報告2,839例,較去年同期增加;新加坡疫情自高峰下降,平均單日新增33例病例,惟仍高於去年同期;韓國疫情持平,就診陽性率2‰;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.3‰。
RzxjqEviDVDOzw1G0PXMNQ.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 22–24 (25 May–14 June): China's epidemic is rising, with more than 52,000 new cases in May. Japan's epidemic is rising slowly, with an average of 0.19 cases per sentinel clinic. Japan has reported 5 Echo 11 virus cases so far this year, as of 19 June. In Hanoi, Viet Nam, 112 new cases were reported in one week, and the city has cumulatively reported 2,839 cases so far this year as of 13 June, an increase over the same period last year. Singapore's epidemic has declined from its peak, with an average of 33 new cases per day, still higher than the same period last year. South Korea's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 2‰. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.

JtFhxGkgS225uEv7Wzqfqw.zh: 日本近1週(6/2-8)定點平均報告數為2.28例,較前1週1.87例上升,單週平均報告數為1999年以來最高,其中以櫪木縣7.19例為高,其次為群馬縣6.32例,當局呼籲孕婦採取防護措施。
JtFhxGkgS225uEv7Wzqfqw.en: In the most recent week (2–8 June), Japan's sentinel average was 2.28, up from 1.87 the previous week. The weekly average is the highest since 1999, with Tochigi Prefecture highest at 7.19, followed by Gunma Prefecture at 6.32. Authorities urge pregnant women to take protective measures.

iEmRc6otLTedxDXjrNhMqg.zh: 日本疫情嚴峻,近1週(6/2-8)通報3,044例,較前1週2,329例上升715例,為2018年以來新高,病例數以東京都(194)為多,其次為琦玉縣(175)。今年迄今已累計逾2.8萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例。該國於6/13發布疫情監測報告,今年截至5月下旬病例數為去年全年病例數逾5倍,其中近60%為青少年。自2024年以來陸續於東京/大阪/烏取縣/沖繩縣檢出抗藥性菌株,另今年4月報告1例新生兒因感染抗藥性菌株出現呼吸衰竭、肺動脈高壓及腎衰竭等症狀死亡,當局表示病例數仍持續增加,所有年齡層皆須注意防範措施。
iEmRc6otLTedxDXjrNhMqg.en: Japan's epidemic is severe. In the most recent week (2–8 June), 3,044 cases were reported, up 715 from 2,329 the previous week, the highest since 2018. Tokyo Metropolis (194) reported the most, followed by Saitama Prefecture (175). So far this year, more than 28,000 cumulative cases have been reported, and severe and fatal infant cases have been reported. On 13 June the country issued an epidemic surveillance report: as of late May this year, cases were more than five times the total for all of last year, and nearly 60% were adolescents. Drug-resistant strains have been detected since 2024 in Tokyo, Osaka, Tottori and Okinawa prefectures. In April this year, a newborn died after infection with a drug-resistant strain, with symptoms including respiratory failure, pulmonary hypertension and renal failure. Authorities say case numbers continue to rise, and precautions are needed in all age groups.

_GOzSYapNyYx1FyTePqBQQ.zh: 日本三重縣報告1例死亡病例,為男性獸醫,於5月治療感染SFTS之貓隻後,出現呼吸困難等症狀就醫,數日後死亡,病患無蜱蟲咬傷痕跡,獸醫診所工作人員及貓飼主均未出現症狀。該國自2013年截至今年4月下旬累計報告1,071例,其中117例死亡;今年截至6/1累計報告56例,該國每年報告40-130例間,病例主要集中於西部地區。
_GOzSYapNyYx1FyTePqBQQ.en: Mie Prefecture in Japan reported one death, a male veterinarian. In May he treated a cat infected with SFTS, then developed symptoms including breathing difficulty and sought medical care; he died several days later. The patient had no tick bite marks, and staff at the veterinary clinic and the cat's owner have shown no symptoms. Japan has reported 1,071 cases cumulatively from 2013 to late April this year, including 117 deaths. As of 1 June this year, 56 cases have been reported. Japan reports 40–130 cases per year, mainly concentrated in western regions.

xtk4KQ3j5AK0OBymzc2H1A.zh: 疫情更新: 2025年第21週(5/19-25)全球陽性率3.19%,除非洲以外,各區陽性率皆顯著增加。  中國疫情經高點後呈下降趨勢,第23週(6/2-8)定醫門診陽性率20.3%,低於過去兩週,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方省份,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高(5月份65%)。 香港疫情已呈明顯下降趨勢,第23週(6/1-7)陽性率6.95%,低於過去三週,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(90%)。 日本今年第23週(6/2-8)累計新增3,544例病例,定醫平均病例數0.92,較前兩週疫情略升,變異株NB.1.8.1佔多數(41%)。 孟加拉疫情上升,今年截至6/12累計新增240例病例,陽性率在第17週後顯著上升,變異株B.1.1.529佔多數。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,除非洲以外,各區域皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高(27%),NB.1.8.1占比次高(21%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
xtk4KQ3j5AK0OBymzc2H1A.en: Epidemic update: In week 21 of 2025 (19–25 May), global positivity was 3.19%, with significant increases in all regions except Africa. China: after its peak, the epidemic is declining. Sentinel clinic positivity in week 23 (2–8 June) was 20.3%, lower than in the previous two weeks. Positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern ones, and NB.1.8.1 accounted for the highest share (65% in May). Hong Kong: the epidemic has clearly declined. Positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 6.95%, lower than in the previous three weeks, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also declined. Wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 accounts for the highest share (90%). Japan: 3,544 new cases were reported in week 23 (2–8 June) this year. The sentinel average was 0.92, slightly higher than in the previous two weeks, and NB.1.8.1 was the majority variant (41%). Bangladesh: the epidemic is rising. 240 new cases have been reported so far this year as of 12 June. Positivity rose significantly after week 17, and variant B.1.1.529 is the majority. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with increases in all regions except Africa. The current most prevalent global variant is LP.8.1 (27%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (21%). k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

Case numbers continue to rise, and the peak is assessed not yet to have been reached. The largest numbers were in Niigata Prefecture (73) and Miyazaki Prefecture (51).
