Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible, and recommends booster doses for children to avoid severe illness.

-4dozT7ONUS89PqlIdA1pQ.zh: 日本今年截至3/30累計報告4,771例,已超過去年全年病例數(4,054例),近一週(3/24-30)新增578例,為2018年以來最高,其中,以新潟縣(73例)、兵庫縣及沖繩縣為多。另東京都通報1例新生兒死亡案例,近期於大阪及沖繩等地發現抗藥性菌株,當局呼籲嬰幼兒儘早接種疫苗,小學學童補接種疫苗。
-4dozT7ONUS89PqlIdA1pQ.en: Japan has reported 4,771 cumulative cases so far this year as of 30 March, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 4,054 cases. A further 578 cases were reported in the past week (24–30 March), the highest weekly figure since 2018. Cases were concentrated in Niigata Prefecture (73 cases), Hyogo Prefecture and Okinawa Prefecture. Tokyo Metropolitan Government reported one neonatal death. Drug-resistant strains have recently been found in areas including Osaka and Okinawa. Authorities urge early vaccination of infants and catch-up vaccination for elementary school children.

mGM8yGICOBaLrsvp2VHe7A.zh: 日本自今年初迄3/19報告2,672例病例,其中東京佔26%。該國於2012年前報告病例數低於900例,惟自2013年起上升,2022年病例數首次突破萬例,2023-24年分別報告14,906及14,663例。另2023年全年報告37例先天性梅毒,創歷史新高。
mGM8yGICOBaLrsvp2VHe7A.en: Japan reported 2,672 cases from the start of this year to 19 March, of which 26% were in Tokyo. Before 2012 the country reported fewer than 900 cases a year, but numbers have risen since 2013. Cases exceeded 10,000 for the first time in 2022, with 14,906 reported in 2023 and 14,663 in 2024. In addition, 37 cases of congenital syphilis were reported for the whole of 2023, a record high.

8MUFmARWPnhVRt6Xrswy_g.zh: 日本第10週(3/3-9)報告482例,今年累計報告2,924例,為2018年以來最高,以大阪府43例為多,其次為新潟縣39例及宮崎縣33例,專家表示許多慢性咳嗽病患未就醫,實際病例數可能更高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。
8MUFmARWPnhVRt6Xrswy_g.en: Japan reported 482 cases in week 10 (3–9 March), bringing the year's cumulative total to 2,924, the highest since 2018. Osaka Prefecture had the most, with 43 cases, followed by Niigata Prefecture with 39 and Miyazaki Prefecture with 33. Experts say many patients with chronic cough have not sought medical care, so actual case numbers may be higher. Authorities have planned a vaccination programme.

4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.

BNt1W_-bmTJrdfQCuElqYQ.zh: 日本疫情持續,報告第10週(3/3-9)感染性腸胃炎定點報告病例數為11.38人,較前一週增加1.55人,創十年同期新高,都道府縣定點報告病例數前三名分別為大分縣、愛媛縣及香川縣。當局提醒民眾注意並落實手部衛生。
BNt1W_-bmTJrdfQCuElqYQ.en: Outbreaks in Japan continue. In week 10 (3–9 March), sentinel-reported infectious gastroenteritis cases reached 11.38 per sentinel site, an increase of 1.55 from the previous week and the highest for the same period in ten years. The three prefectures with the most sentinel reports were Oita, Ehime and Kagawa. Authorities urge the public to be aware of the risk and to practise hand hygiene.

lf7oNYtAGc6Xp6ZxemVKpg.zh: 日本神戶報告某餐廳疫情,民眾於2/28在某餐廳食用雞肉、生魚片等食物後,用餐之16人中有10人自3/1出現腹瀉、發燒等症狀。當局於4位病患檢體檢測出病原,並下令該餐廳停業。
lf7oNYtAGc6Xp6ZxemVKpg.en: Japan's Kobe has reported an outbreak linked to a restaurant. On 28 February, 16 people dined at a restaurant and ate foods including chicken and sashimi; 10 of them developed diarrhoea, fever and other symptoms from 1 March. Authorities detected the pathogen in samples from 4 patients and ordered the restaurant to suspend operations.

n-f0pv0e_rvqKZjQaig8vA.zh: 日本岐阜縣報告某餐飲公司餐盒疫情,自2月底截至3/6累計320例病例,其中1例死亡,死者為40歲男性,於2/25-27食用該公司餐盒,於3/1死亡,其檢體檢出病原,當局已禁止該公司營業,刻正調查中。另鳥取縣發生兩起疫情,分別為某和菓子製造商與某旅館餐點,前者於2/26-3/2期間販售草莓大福,累計99例病例,病患體內與餐點皆檢測出病原;後者於2/25-3/3供應餐點,累計76例病例,病患與烹調人員體內皆檢測出病原;前述兩場所皆已停業。
n-f0pv0e_rvqKZjQaig8vA.en: Gifu Prefecture in Japan has reported an outbreak linked to packed meals from a catering company: from late February to 6 March, 320 cases were reported cumulatively, including 1 death. The deceased, a 40-year-old man, ate the company's packed meals on 25–27 February and died on 1 March; his specimens tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities have ordered the company to cease operations, and an investigation is ongoing. Tottori Prefecture also had two outbreaks: one linked to a Japanese confectionery manufacturer, which sold strawberry daifuku from 26 February to 2 March, with 99 cases cumulatively, and the pathogen was detected in patients and in the food; and one linked to meals served at a hotel from 25 February to 3 March, with 76 cases cumulatively, and the pathogen was detected in patients and cooks. Both venues have been closed.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

-3XuUZ_w_vskJqsXZ8243g.zh: 日本兵庫縣明石市報告1例病例,為該市2020年以來首例,病患為20多歲女性,未曾接種疫苗,於2月中旬曾前往越南,3/1出現發燒、倦怠等症狀,惟3/2仍搭乘大眾交通工具至關西機場,出境前往臺灣,3/4返國後高燒,於6日就醫後確診。
-3XuUZ_w_vskJqsXZ8243g.en: Akashi City in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan, reported one case, the city's first since 2020. The patient is a woman in her 20s who had not been vaccinated. She travelled to Viet Nam in mid-February. She developed fever and fatigue on 1 March, but on 2 March she still took public transport to Kansai Airport and left Japan for Taiwan. She returned to Japan on 4 March with a high fever, and was confirmed after seeking medical care on 6 March.

Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.zh: 越南河內市今年迄今累計報告625例,去年同期則無報告病例,該市疫情自年初迅速蔓延,多數病患未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,其中1歲以下幼兒病例持續增加,評估疫情將持續,尤其該地區近期連續降雨,增加傳播風險,當局已進行疫苗接種工作。 日本橫濱市於2/26-27新增2例,為20多歲女性及40多歲男性,2人分別自泰國及越南返國,個案無流行病學關聯;該國今年截至2/26累計報告6例,其中1例本土病例,5例為境外移入,多來自越南。 美國德州疫情更新,截至3/4,累計報告159例,其中22例住院,1例死亡;鄰近新墨西哥州利郡累計報告9例。該國今年截至2/27報告3起疫情,共9州報告164例,其中32例住院,多數病例未接種疫苗。
Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.en: Hanoi, Viet Nam, has reported 625 cumulative cases so far this year, with no cases reported in the same period last year. The outbreak in the city has spread rapidly since the start of the year. Most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated, and cases among children under one year old continue to rise. Authorities expect the outbreak to continue, especially as recent continuous rain in the area increases transmission risk. Vaccination work is under way. In Yokohama City, Japan, 2 cases were added on 26–27 February: a woman in her 20s and a man in his 40s, who had returned from Thailand and Viet Nam respectively, with no epidemiological link between them. Japan has reported 6 cases this year as of 26 February, 1 of them locally acquired and 5 imported, mostly from Viet Nam. In Texas, USA, as of 4 March, 159 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 22 were hospitalized and 1 died. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. The United States reported 3 outbreaks this year as of 27 February, with 164 cases in 9 states, of which 32 were hospitalized; most cases were unvaccinated.

hx-03wT8canttB_hxe19Lw.zh: 日本公布自2/9-13期間發生東京某家餐廳集體食物中毒事件,累計81人腹瀉、嘔吐,經調查感染源為一名有症狀廚師,並於病患與環境中採檢出諾羅病毒,當局勒令該店停業3日。
hx-03wT8canttB_hxe19Lw.en: Japan reported a mass food poisoning incident at a Tokyo restaurant between 9 and 13 February. A total of 81 people had diarrhoea and vomiting. The investigation found that the source was a cook with symptoms, and norovirus was detected in patients and in the environment. Authorities ordered the restaurant to close for 3 days.

z1ty4F28fQtNuoSdjpkY3Q.zh: 日本於1/25報告關東地區自去年8月迄今累計發現7例感染伊科11型病毒之重症病例,其中3例因急性肝衰竭症狀後死亡,死者皆為1個月之嬰兒。另4例嬰兒則為腦膜炎症狀,均已治癒出院。
z1ty4F28fQtNuoSdjpkY3Q.en: On 25 January, Japan reported that seven severe cases infected with echovirus type 11 had been identified in the Kanto region since August last year. Three of these cases died of acute liver failure, and all three deceased were one-month-old infants. Four other infants presented with meningitis-like symptoms; all have recovered and been discharged.

kvyDeUkW3mxp8KOffhLNOw.zh: 日本第4週(1/20-1/26)報告5.4萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數11.06例,該國於2024年52週報告逾31萬例(定醫平均病例數64.39例)達高峰後,病例數呈下降趨勢。近期病例數以山形縣、新潟縣及石川縣為多,部分地區仍有病床不足情形,專家表示近期新增病例數雖趨緩,惟須留意B型流感可能取代A型流感,亦應注意新冠等傳染病,呼籲民眾仍需採取防護措施。 韓國第4週(1/19-1/25)流感門診就診率為36.5‰,該國於今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)就診率99.8‰達高峰後呈下降趨勢,惟目前仍高於閾,當局密切監測春節假期期間流感及呼吸道傳染病情形。
kvyDeUkW3mxp8KOffhLNOw.en: Japan reported over 54,000 cases in week 4 (20–26 January), with an average of 11.06 cases per sentinel clinic. After peaking in week 52 of 2024 with over 310,000 cases (an average of 64.39 per sentinel clinic), case numbers have been declining. Recent cases are concentrated in Yamagata, Niigata and Ishikawa prefectures, and some areas still have insufficient hospital beds. Experts say that although new cases have slowed, attention should be paid to influenza B possibly replacing influenza A, and COVID-19 and other infectious diseases should also be monitored; the public is urged to continue taking protective measures. South Korea's influenza outpatient visit rate in week 4 (19–25 January) was 36.5‰. After peaking at 99.8‰ in week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the rate has declined but remains above the threshold, and authorities are closely monitoring influenza and respiratory infections during the Lunar New Year holiday.

UgLgNLCzYajirv-78HPNxg.zh: 日本北海道於本年1/17公布去年12/29發生某大樓集體食物中毒事件,累計報告37例病例,其中21例經採檢確診,經調查,當局確認起因為地下室水塔受汙染,已完成消毒換水。
UgLgNLCzYajirv-78HPNxg.en: On 17 January, Hokkaido, Japan, announced a mass food-poisoning incident at a building on 29 December last year. A total of 37 cases were reported, 21 of which were confirmed by testing. The investigation determined that the cause was contamination of the underground water tank; disinfection and water replacement have been completed.

Y32Jot8CG4Et_4YIJAtUyw.zh: 日本第2週(1/6-1/12)定醫門診平均病例數1.11例,較前1週(12/30-1/5) 0.77例增加,為10年同期以來最高。
Y32Jot8CG4Et_4YIJAtUyw.en: In week 2 (6–12 January), Japan's average number of cases per sentinel clinic was 1.11, up from 0.77 in the previous week (30 December–5 January). This is the highest for the same period in 10 years.

YLdaOLAH8kkeOVKOhabYYA.zh: 日本第2週(1/6-1/12)累計報告17.2萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數35.02例,全國超過警報標準,近期已出現醫療量能不足之情形。 美國類流感門診就診率由6.1%下降至5.4%,第2週(1/5-1/11)流感陽性率為18.8%,較前1週18.6%略升,惟死亡數上升,美國CDC表示本週較上週相關指標持平或下降可能受假期影響,評估疫情尚未達到高峰,未來數週疫情可能加劇。
YLdaOLAH8kkeOVKOhabYYA.en: Japan: In week 2 (6–12 January), 172,000+ cases were reported cumulatively, with an average of 35.02 cases per sentinel clinic, exceeding the national alert standard; medical capacity has recently become insufficient in some areas. United States: The influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate fell from 6.1% to 5.4%. Influenza test positivity in week 2 (5–11 January) was 18.8%, slightly up from 18.6% the previous week, while deaths rose. The US CDC said that this week's indicators were flat or lower than the previous week, which may be affected by holidays. It assessed that the outbreak has not yet reached its peak and may intensify over the coming weeks.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

wrCaIqpUvo62pqS5bt568A.zh: 日本於1/13報告2024年全年累計14,663例病例,以東京都3,703例為多,其次為大阪府1,906例、福岡縣880例,去年病例數略低於2023年(14,906 例),惟較15年前病例數增加15倍,其中,男性增加10倍,女性增加23倍。
wrCaIqpUvo62pqS5bt568A.en: On 13 January, Japan reported 14,663 cumulative cases for 2024, with the largest numbers in Tokyo Metropolis (3,703), followed by Osaka Prefecture (1,906) and Fukuoka Prefecture (880). Last year's case count was slightly lower than the 14,906 cases in 2023, but it is 15 times the number reported 15 years ago. Among men, cases increased 10-fold, and among women, 23-fold.

APSOZPkS81oiS2anwdTqAw.zh: 日本於去年第51週(12/16-12/22)累計報告21.1萬餘例,定醫門診平均病例數42.66例,為10年來最高,全國有36個都道府縣超過警報標準,該國病例數快速上升,第51週病例數為前1週2倍以上,評估病例將持續增加;韓國第52週類流感門診就診率為73.9 ‰,較前1週31.3‰顯著上升,當局於去年12/20發布警報,並呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
APSOZPkS81oiS2anwdTqAw.en: Japan's cumulative reports in week 51 of last year (16–22 December) exceeded 211,000 cases, with an average of 42.66 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest in 10 years. Thirty-six prefectures nationwide exceeded the alert threshold. Japan's case numbers are rising rapidly: the number in week 51 was more than double that of the previous week, and the assessment is that cases will continue to rise. South Korea's influenza-like illness outpatient visit rate in week 52 was 73.9‰, a significant increase from 31.3‰ the previous week. Authorities issued an alert on 20 December last year and urge the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

zdQGOdlKWUC5lUD9nzBScg.zh: 中國今年疫情嚴峻,幾乎全年居於嚴重呼吸道感染住院病例之病原首位,11月起陽性率已逐漸下降,影響全年齡層;日本今年下半年疫情亦嚴峻,自6月起疫情持續上升,至11月達高峰,峰為往年高峰近2倍,目前已逐週下降,惟仍處於極高水平。
zdQGOdlKWUC5lUD9nzBScg.en: China's severe respiratory infection situation in 2024 has been serious; Mycoplasma pneumoniae has been the leading pathogen among hospitalised severe respiratory infection cases for nearly the whole year. Positivity has gradually declined since November, affecting all age groups. Japan's epidemic was also severe in the second half of 2024: cases rose continuously from June and peaked in November at nearly twice the level of previous years' peaks. Cases are now falling each week but remain at an extremely high level.

cUAwQlYPOSXgnf6G_RAylg.zh: 日本今年定點報告數自4月起持續緩升,11月起出現驟升,目前處於高峰,升幅已趨緩,疫情集中於關東地區及北方之青森縣。
cUAwQlYPOSXgnf6G_RAylg.en: Japan's sentinel reports this year rose gradually from April and surged from November; the epidemic is now at its peak, although the rate of increase has slowed. The outbreak is concentrated in the Kanto region and in Aomori Prefecture in the north.

oIKhRlCqu5JmBrxVmjPRlA.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第48週(11/25-12/1)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.7%)及非洲區(8.1%)為高。 中國公布11月新冠感染疫情,新增35例重症及11例死亡,近期發燒門診就診量持平,類流感病例佔比略升,新冠陽性率處低點,以XDV及JN.1為主流變異株。 日本病例數連續4週上升,第50週(12/9-12/15)病例數逾20,000例,住院數亦持續增加,其中北海道及東北地區病例數快速增加;檢驗報告顯示以KP.3.1.1及KP.3.3為主流變異株,惟XEC變異株近期快速上升,佔比已達10%以上。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區及歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
oIKhRlCqu5JmBrxVmjPRlA.en: Epidemic update: In week 48 of 2024 (25 November–1 December), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.7%) and the African Region (8.1%). China reported 35 new severe COVID-19 cases and 11 deaths in November. Recently, fever clinic visits have been flat and the proportion of influenza-like cases has risen slightly, while the COVID-19 positivity rate is at a low point; XDV and JN.1 are the main circulating variants. Japan's case numbers have risen for four consecutive weeks; in week 50 (9–15 December), over 20,000 cases were reported, hospitalisations also continued to rise, and the Hokkaido and Tohoku regions saw rapid increases. Test reports show that KP.3.1.1 and KP.3.3 are the main variants, but XEC has risen rapidly recently and now accounts for over 10%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African and European regions and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

0PBSZTAmolxRLvuwPHgZTg.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第47週(11/18-11/24)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.9%)及非洲區(6.2%)為高。 WHO於12/9發布XEC變異株風險評估,該變異株由第44週(10/28-11/3)的26.9%上升至第47週(11/18-11/24)的36.8%,依目前資料顯示該病毒株免疫逃脫風險較低,現有JN.1或KP.2疫苗可提供保護,與其他變異株相較,並無明顯增加之公共衛生負擔及風險,評估整體風險為低。 美洲區近期整體呈現下降趨勢,惟南美洲東南部地區近期陽性率處高點,近期智利、巴拉圭及烏拉圭疫情處上升趨勢。 日本新增病例數持續上升,第49週(12/2-12/8)新增15,000餘例,較前一週11,900餘例上升,新增住院數亦持續增加。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區、歐洲區及東南亞區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
0PBSZTAmolxRLvuwPHgZTg.en: Epidemic update: In week 47 of 2024 (18–24 November), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.9%) and the African Region (6.2%). On 9 December, WHO issued a risk assessment for the XEC variant: its share rose from 26.9% in week 44 (28 October–3 November) to 36.8% in week 47 (18–24 November). Current data suggest that this virus strain has a low risk of immune escape, that existing JN.1 or KP.2 vaccines can provide protection, and that there is no obvious increase in public health burden or risk compared with other variants; the overall risk is assessed as low. Recently, the Region of the Americas has shown an overall declining trend, but positivity in the south-eastern part of South America is at a high point, and Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay are trending upward. Japan's new cases continued to rise, with over 15,000 new cases in week 49 (2–8 December), up from over 11,900 the previous week, and new hospitalisations also continued to rise. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African, European and South-East Asian regions, and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

wvQpcQLGt2NXet9aEL84-A.zh: 日本今年定點報告數自4月起持續緩升,10月起升幅加劇,疫情明顯集中於關東地區,包括東京都(11/21)、埼玉縣(12/4)、千葉縣(12/4)、神奈川縣(12/5)均已發布流行警報。
wvQpcQLGt2NXet9aEL84-A.en: In Japan, sentinel-site reports have risen steadily since April this year, with the increase accelerating from October. Cases are concentrated in the Kanto region, and epidemic alerts have been issued for Tokyo Metropolis (21 November), Saitama Prefecture (4 December), Chiba Prefecture (4 December) and Kanagawa Prefecture (5 December).

GErcMg8pn8DHV4N2V1HOaw.zh: 日本自2022年5月起疫情持續嚴峻迄今,目前維持每週新增280餘例之規模(往年每週新增100餘例),今年截至11月累計報告1.3萬餘例,與去年同期相同,該國去年全年報告近1.5萬例,為歷史新高。
GErcMg8pn8DHV4N2V1HOaw.en: Japan's syphilis epidemic has remained severe since May 2022. The current weekly number of new cases is about 280 or more, compared with more than 100 per week in previous years. This year, a cumulative total of more than 13,000 cases has been reported as of November, the same as the same period last year. The country reported nearly 15,000 cases last year as a whole, a historic high.

ftH0rgoln_ga0UmgVxiAkA.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第46週(11/11-11/17)全球陽性率約12.8%,陽性率以歐洲區(13.7%)、美洲區(10.6%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 英國近期多項指標呈下降趨勢,第48週(11/25-12/1)入/住院率及入/住院數皆處低點,當局呼籲民眾儘快接種COVID-19及流感等疫苗,降低感染呼吸道傳染病風險。 日本第48週(11/25-12/1)新增13,583例,病例數較前1週(11/18-11/24) 之11,499例上升,住院數亦較前1週增加,其中北海道及東北地區病例數顯著上升,推估未來病例數將持續增加,當局已針對冬季疫情進行擴大整備工作。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期持平,其中,非洲區及東南亞區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ftH0rgoln_ga0UmgVxiAkA.en:
Situation update: In week 46 of 2024 (11–17 November), the global positivity rate was about 12.8%, highest in the European Region (13.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.6%) and the African Region (5.0%).

The United Kingdom has seen several recent indicators decline. In week 48 (25 November–1 December), hospital admission rates and numbers of admissions were at low levels. Authorities urge people to get COVID-19 and influenza vaccines as soon as possible to reduce the risk of respiratory infections.

Japan reported 13,583 new cases in week 48 (25 November–1 December), up from 11,499 in the previous week (18–24 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week, with notable increases in case numbers in Hokkaido and the Tohoku region. Cases are expected to keep rising, and authorities have expanded preparations for the winter season.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has been stable recently, with slight increases in the African Region and South-East Asia Region, while other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance. WHO recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.

JUFNyPn7BGc8a3C787JwYA.zh: 日本疫情持續上升,單週定醫平均報告數達2.84,為近10年最高,目前仍呈陡升趨勢,該國往年疫情高峰多發生於10至12月,峰介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發(2015及2016年)峰分別為0.9及1.6。
JUFNyPn7BGc8a3C787JwYA.en: Cases in Japan continue to rise. The average weekly number of reports per sentinel medical institution reached 2.84, the highest in 10 years, and the curve is still climbing steeply. In past years, Japan's epidemic peaks have mostly occurred between October and December, with peaks typically between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the previous two outbreaks (2015 and 2016) were 0.9 and 1.6, respectively.

tpGe1ONN45k7jBbmeSRfIA.zh: 2024年第43週(10/28-11/3)全球陽性率約16.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(17.8%)、美洲區(12.6%)及非洲區(3.7%)為高。 美國近期處低點,近1週(11/3-11/9)陽性率3.6%,近期廢水樣本病毒量、陽性率、急診就診率及住院率持續下降,死亡數處低點,變異株以KP.3.1.1占比52%為多,其次為XEC變異株。 日本第46週(11/11-11/17)新增9,406例,病例數較前1週(11/4-11/10) 的7,246例上升,住院數亦較前1週增加,該國以KP.3.3及其衍生變異株為主流株。
tpGe1ONN45k7jBbmeSRfIA.en:
Situation update: In week 43 of 2024 (28 October–3 November), the global positivity rate was about 16.2%, highest in the European Region (17.8%), the Region of the Americas (12.6%) and the African Region (3.7%).

The United States is at low levels recently: positivity was 3.6% in the most recent week (3–9 November). Viral load in wastewater samples, positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have continued to decline, and deaths are at a low level. KP.3.1.1 accounts for the largest share of variants at 52%, followed by XEC variants.

Japan reported 9,406 new cases in week 46 (11–17 November), up from 7,246 in the previous week (4–10 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week. KP.3.3 and its derived variants are the main circulating strains in the country.

7Q4nHY60HPpriucvfdf14g.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第42週(10/21-10/27)全球陽性率約19.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(21.1%)、美洲區(13.1%)及非洲區(6.7%)為高。 日本以KP.3.3及其衍生株為主流變異株,XEC占比約4.3%,東京都XEC占比上升,近期(10/14-10/20)占比達25%。  WHO更新全球疫情資訊:  全球近28天(9/16-10/13)新增逾33萬例病例及4,500例死亡,病例數較前28天分別上升18%及下降25%;住院數及重症數分別新增逾2.5萬例及800例,住院數及重症數較前28天期間分別下降9%及39%。 10月中旬(10/7-10/13),全球主要流行變異株KP.3.1.1、XEC、JN.1、KP.3占比分別為51.1%、17.2%、12.2%、10.9%,其中變異株KP.3.1.1及XEC占比呈上升趨勢。
7Q4nHY60HPpriucvfdf14g.en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (21–27 October), the global positivity rate was about 19.4%, highest in the European Region (21.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.1%) and the African Region (6.7%).

In Japan, KP.3.3 and its derived strains are the main circulating variants, and XEC accounts for about 4.3%. The XEC share has risen in Tokyo Metropolis, reaching 25% in the recent period (14–20 October).

WHO global update: In the past 28 days (16 September–13 October), more than 330,000 new cases and 4,500 deaths were reported globally. Compared with the previous 28 days, cases rose by 18% and deaths fell by 25%. New hospital admissions and severe cases totalled more than 25,000 and 800, respectively. Compared with the previous 28-day period, hospitalizations fell by 9% and severe cases by 39%.

In mid-October (7–13 October), the shares of the main global variants were KP.3.1.1 51.1%, XEC 17.2%, JN.1 12.2% and KP.3 10.9%. The shares of KP.3.1.1 and XEC are trending upward.

DmKgw7qHTlr_q948LjD2Pg.zh: 2024年第41週(10/7-10/13)全球陽性率約21.2%,陽性率以歐洲區(22.9%)、美洲區(12.9%)及非洲區(5.2%)為高。 日本第42週(10/14-10/20)病例數持續下降,定醫報告病例數為9,100餘例,每定醫點平均1.86例,第34-37週以KP.3.3變異株占比為高。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比上升。 歐洲區以KP.3.1.1變異株占比最高,其次為XEC變異株。
DmKgw7qHTlr_q948LjD2Pg.en:
Situation update: In week 41 of 2024 (7–13 October), the global positivity rate was about 21.2%, highest in the European Region (22.9%), the Region of the Americas (12.9%) and the African Region (5.2%).

Japan's case numbers continued to decline in week 42 (14–20 October). Sentinel medical institutions reported more than 9,100 cases, an average of 1.86 cases per sentinel site. KP.3.3 accounted for the highest share of variants in weeks 34–37.

In the United States, recent positivity, emergency department visit rates and hospitalization rates have all trended downward. The main circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants has risen.

In the European Region, KP.3.1.1 accounts for the highest share of variants, followed by XEC.

W9ddQHSCTvhgbOS1ZzWOJA.zh: 美國今年4至9月疫情上升,所有年齡層報告數均增加,以未成年族群增幅較高,其中以4歲以下族群最為顯著,並於8月達高峰後持續迄今,當局呼籲醫護工作者提高警覺,並注意抗生素之使用。 日本疫情持續上升,單週定醫平均報告數達1.9,為近10年最高,且仍呈陡升趨勢,該國往年疫情高峰多發生於10至12月,峰介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發峰分別為0.9及1.6。
W9ddQHSCTvhgbOS1ZzWOJA.en:
United States: Cases have risen from April to September this year, with increases across all age groups, higher among minors, and most pronounced in children aged 4 and under. The peak occurred in August, and cases have continued since then. Authorities urge healthcare workers to remain alert and to pay attention to antibiotic use.

Japan: Cases continue to rise. The average weekly number of reports per sentinel medical institution reached 1.9, the highest in 10 years, and the curve is still climbing steeply. In past years, Japan's epidemic peaks have mostly occurred between October and December, with peaks between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the previous two outbreaks (2015 and 2016) were 0.9 and 1.6, respectively.

zMWDXh7VcEbSIipd-DpKiw.zh: 日本今年自4月起疫情升溫,5月驟升,而後持續上升至今,週平均報告數已超越前次(2016年)大爆發時期;該國往年疫情高峰為10至12月,週平均報告數峰多介於0.4至0.6間,前二次爆發之峰分別為0.9及1.6,今年最新數據(38週)則為1.5。
zMWDXh7VcEbSIipd-DpKiw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen since April this year, surged in May, and has continued to rise to date. The weekly average number of reports has already exceeded that of the previous major outbreak in 2016. Japan's usual annual peak occurs from October to December, with weekly average peaks typically between 0.4 and 0.6. The peaks of the two previous outbreaks were 0.9 and 1.6, and the latest figure (week 38) is 1.5.
